whatItIs: quantum-game is an open-source project in the games and learning category. It is maintained by stared and primarily looks like a JavaScript codebase. Quantum Game (old version) - a puzzle game with real quantum mechanics in a browser

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches games and learning workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: **A note: this repository is an old Quanutm Game (2014-2016), no longer maintained. The new one (2019-) is at quantumgame.io.** Quantum Game - play with photons, superposition and entanglement. In your browser! With true quantum mechanics underneath! The repository also appears to be archival or no longer actively maintained, which matters when evaluating it for current production use.
